description: This file defines a React functional component 'MindmapCanvas' that renders an interactive mind map visualization using SVG. It includes complex layout calculations, rendering of various node types, connectors, and user interaction features such as zooming, panning, and node selection. The file appears to be part of a frontend application, specifically for visualizing career paths and related nodes; the presence of type imports from '@/lib/mindmapApi' suggests it interacts with a backend API for node data.

methods.name: clamp
methods.description: Restricts a number 'n' to be within the specified min and max boundaries.

methods.name: normString
methods.description: Converts an unknown value to a trimmed string, handling null or undefined.

methods.name: numberOrNull
methods.description: Converts an unknown value to a number or null if invalid.

methods.description: Attempts to extract a percentage range label from a node's data fields.

methods.name: isLikelyStepNode
methods.description: Heuristic to determine if a node likely represents a step or milestone.

methods.name: computeLevels
methods.description: Computes hierarchical levels of nodes based on edges from a center node.

methods.name: nodeLane
methods.description: Assigns a layout lane (positioning category) to a node based on heuristics.

methods.name: computeLayout
methods.description: Calculates fixed SVG positions for nodes based on layout logic.
